    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The map is a list labelled with its title; every tile is an item with its name, kind and tokens
      - listitem: The fill level is text in the bar – its color is extra, not the only signal
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A tile's card shows while you point at it; a click pins it – a second click, Escape or the block leaving the map lets it go
      - listitem: "Text that changes after a compaction rolls: the old line slides up and out, the new one comes in from below"
      - listitem: "Before | After glides between the two maps: kept blocks stay, summarized and dropped ones grow back in while the summary shrinks away – and back"
      - listitem: Tiles keep their order and glide to their new place and size when anything changes
      - listitem: New parts fade in where the layout puts them; parts that leave shrink to nothing
      - listitem: A shine sweeps over the used token count all the time
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion tiles jump to their place
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The area keeps its height; tiles too small for a label show only their color – point at them for the details
      - listitem: Under 480px the area is shorter and the numbers move to a line of their own
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Pass every part every time something changes – ids keep tiles in place and let them glide
      - listitem: "Order matters: the layout keeps it, so put stable parts (system, tools) first and growing ones later"
      - listitem: To show compaction, shrink the squeezed parts to 0 over a moment while a summary block grows
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-cmpc, e.g. --ui-cmpc-file-bg / --ui-cmpc-file-edge
